Description.TranslatedText: --DY = (--DTC - RFSTDTC) + 1 if --DTC >= RFSTDTC, else (--DTC - RFSTDTC). Only when both dates are complete; otherwise null. Replaces the source value, which in TU/TR/RS was the planned visit day (VISITDY).
Kept from the source dataset; unique within USUBJID.

By event date vs. RFXSTDTC/RFXENDTC: before RFXSTDTC -> SCREENING; RFXSTDTC to RFXENDTC -> TREATMENT; after RFXENDTC -> FOLLOW-UP. Partial or missing date -> null. Screen failures -> SCREENING. Protocol milestones -> SCREENING. Findings at the BASELINE visit (VISITNUM 3) on the RFXSTDTC date are pre-dose -> SCREENING. Same rule as P1.

'Y' on the last record with a non-missing result that is pre-dose, per USUBJID, --LNKID, --TESTCD, --EVAL, --EVALID. Pre-dose = --DTC date before RFXSTDTC, or at the BASELINE visit (VISITNUM 3) when the date is on RFXSTDTC or partial. Null otherwise.
Null when ARMNRS is not null (52 screen failures; source value 'Scrnfail' / 'Screen Failure'). Otherwise kept from source.
'Y' when VISIT does not start with UNSCHEDULED (planned visit); null unscheduled visits. No TV dataset in this project.
'Y' when SVPRESP = 'Y' (SV holds only visits that took place); null otherwise.

Subject 01-711-1143 has two unscheduled visits after WEEK 12 (VISITNUM 9). The source numbers the 2013-06-22 visit 9.1 in SV, which is the planned WEEK 14 (T) for other subjects, and codes both dates 9.2 in TR/RS. Unscheduled visits get the next free number after the planned visit (P1 rule): 2013-06-22 -> 9.2, 2013-09-22 -> 9.3, VISIT = 'UNSCHEDULED 9.2' / 'UNSCHEDULED 9.3'. SV 2 rows, TR 63 rows (2013-09-22), RS 9 rows (2013-09-22). All other records kept from source.
RSORRES = 'CHECK' (3 OVRLRESP rows, 01-711-1143, 2013-06-22): RSORRES/RSSTRESC null, RSSTAT = 'NOT DONE', RSREASND = 'SOURCE VALUE CHECK'. Not re-derived in SDTM. Other records kept from source.

RSORRES = 'NE' (242 NTRGRESP rows): not evaluable is a result of an assessment that was done, so RSSTAT and RSREASND (source: NOT DONE, 'NOT ASSESSABLE: Image obscured') are set null. RSORRES/RSSTRESC kept.

Each tumor assessment is recorded three times: investigator, and two independent radiologists (--EVAL = INDEPENDENT ASSESSOR, --EVALID = RADIOLOGIST 1/2). --ACPTFL = 'Y' marks Radiologist 1 in every record.
RACE and ETHNIC use codelists C74457/C66790 from CT 2025-09-26; CT 2026-09-25 has only the as-collected codelists RACEC/ETHNICC. Same decision as P1.
SDTMIG 3.4: ARMCD/ARM/ACTARMCD/ACTARM are null for subjects not assigned to an arm; the reason is in ARMNRS (replaces pre-3.3 codes such as 'Scrnfail').
Informed consent date is not in the source data.
DSDECOD 'FINAL LAB VISIT' and 'FINAL RETRIEVAL VISIT' (DSCAT = OTHER EVENT) are sponsor extensions of the extensible codelist OTHEVENT (C150811).

Trial design datasets (TA, TE, TV, TI, TS) are not included. The pharmaversesdtm source has only a TS, which describes the original Alzheimer's study; the synthetic tumor data have no study design or protocol of their own, so TI and the objective and indication parameters of TS would have to be invented. SV SVPRESP is derived from the visit name instead of TV (MT.SVPRESP). Not validated with P21 rules that need these datasets.
